name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell beside each shoulder, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and glutes with your forearms aligned vertically beneath the dumbbells.
Straighten your arms to bring the dumbbells overhead with your upper arms beside your ears.
Lower both dumbbells under control back to shoulder height.
tips: Keep your knees still and your ribs stacked over your hips.
Avoid arching your lower back or letting your wrists bend backward.
